question:
(i) A charged particle enters a uniform magnetic field with velocity perpendicular to the field. Derive expressions for the radius and time period of its circular motion.
(ii) An electron moving with speed $3.0\times10^6\text{ m s}^{-1}$ enters a uniform magnetic field of $2.0\times10^{-3}\text{ T}$ perpendicular to its velocity. Calculate the radius of its path. Given $e=1.6\times10^{-19}\text{ C}$ and $m_e=9.1\times10^{-31}\text{ kg}$.

options.D:
(i) Equating magnetic and centripetal forces, $qvB=\dfrac{mv^2}{r}$ gives $r=\dfrac{mv}{qB}$ and $T=\dfrac{2\pi r}{v}=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$.
(ii) $r=\dfrac{(9.1\times10^{-31})(3.0\times10^6)}{(1.6\times10^{-19})(2.0\times10^{-3})}=8.53\times10^{-3}\,\text{m}\approx8.5\times10^{-3}\,\text{m}$.
